description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Hudson River Trading is a quantitative trading firm that builds sophisticated computing systems for financial markets. The company is seeking Software Engineers graduating in 2027 to create and maintain critical technology and infrastructure, collaborate with engineers developing trading algorithms, and monitor trading in a fast-paced, real-time environment.
Software engineer designing, debugging, and improving software systems through code analysis and algorithm design

Responsibilities:
• In your spare time you: code, tinker, read, explore, break things, and have an insatiable curiosity for all things computer-related — you'll find like-minded people here
• You are capable of working independently and as part of a team to analyze and fix problems quickly
• You can look at code, figure out how it works, and identify how to make it better
• You can describe software designs at a high level (the abstract interface), low level (step-by-step algorithm), and anywhere in between
• You enjoy working with people who push you to be better at what you do

Requirements:
• You are a full-time undergraduate or master's student studying computer science (or a related field) who is eligible for full-time roles in 2027
• Excellent design, debugging, and problem solving skills
• Working experience with C/C++ or Python is required, as are good CS fundamentals
• Knowledge of UNIX operating systems (we use Linux), system/processor performance, and network communication

Preferred:
• Interest in low-level architecture, logic design, and/or verification

Skills:
• You are a full-time undergraduate or master's student studying computer science (or a related field) who is eligible for full-time roles in 2027
• Excellent design, debugging, and problem solving skills

• Knowledge of UNIX operating systems (we use Linux), system/processor performance, and network communication
• Interest in low-level architecture, logic design, and/or verification

Pay: $300K/yr - $300K/yr
